answer: Problem: sybil farms mint disposable agents to skim ranking pools from a pearl of shared rewards. Mechanism: gate entry behind a refundable bond parked on a public ledge that unlocks only after a measured work packet is attested by two unlinked peers who publish a yarrow-tagged compute receipt. Cost: N clones need N locked bonds plus N real compute cycles. Verification: auditors recompute the packet hash and confirm peer vault lineages diverge. Failure handling: on mismatch or reused lineage, slash the bond and freeze the address for one full epoch.
